settings.hero_title: World-Class Express Courier & Air Freight Delivery.
settings.hero_subtitle: Reliable door-to-door international express courier for parcels, prescription medicines, food, documents, and commercial excess baggage to USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and 220+ countries.
settings.address: Sky Worldwide Cargo Hub, Near International Airport Cargo Terminal, Sahar, Mumbai 400099, India.
settings.business_hours: Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM | Sunday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

services.title: International Courier
services.description: Fast door-to-door express parcel delivery to USA, UK, UAE, Canada, and Europe within 2-4 business days.

services.title: Air Cargo Freight
services.description: Commercial cargo shipments, industrial machinery, and palletized commercial air freight.

services.title: Medicine Delivery
services.description: Specialized international shipping for NRI prescription drugs, Ayurvedic medicines, and healthcare equipment.

services.title: Food Items Delivery
services.description: Send homemade sweets, spices, snacks, and non-perishable grocery goods safely to family overseas.

services.title: Parcel Delivery
services.description: Fast door pickup and custom declaration for worldwide gift and personal care parcels.

services.title: Documents
services.description: University transcripts, passports, legal contracts, certificates, and visa applications.

services.title: Excess Baggage
services.description: Avoid airline airport baggage fees by dispatching personal luggage, student baggage, and household items.

services.title: Worldwide Shipping
services.description: Customs cleared global courier dispatch to 220+ international countries with 24/7 GPS tracking.
